verdict.rationale: The pricing docs say new users automatically get a 7-day Free Trial without entering a credit card. After that they can stay on the Lite plan (no credit card required), which includes 10 GB of free storage and free monthly compute. The getting-started docs promise 'Sign up and start querying in minutes', and analysts can load their own data or attach sample shares, so real queries on real data come through self-serve signup with no sales step. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-card signup and of the free-tier limits in practice.
